glycogen-resynthesis-time.label: Time to refill muscle glycogen after depleting exercise
glycogen-resynthesis-time.value: about 24 h with enough carbohydrate (fast phase in the first 0–4 h)

central-recovery-brief.label: Recovery of central fatigue after brief high-intensity exercise
central-recovery-brief.value: typically within about 2 min (peripheral excitation–contraction and reperfusion parts within 3–5 min)
